뜻.n: native word for meaning, also what a person intends
cf: more formal word for meaning or importance; writing and meetings

햇살.n: sun's rays, how the sunshine feels
cf: technical — sunlight as an energy source, solar power
sun's warmth on the body; basking or tanning

끝맺다.n: Native verb meaning to finish or wrap up a speech, writing, or task; focuses on ending it.
cf: To reach a conclusion or judgment after reasoning or discussion; focuses on the decided outcome.
active; an author or team wraps up a work
to be concluded; to be signed (contract, treaty, deal)
passive: a contract or treaty gets formally signed
active: formally sign a contract or treaty

공정성.n: Abstract quality or degree of being fair; typical for judging referees, trials, institutions
cf: Fairness as a basic condition or ideal, often in compounds; also the root
formal — balance across groups or cases, policy and law

각축장.n: the place or field where rivals compete
cf: the fierce contest itself, close match between rivals

널어놓다.e: to hang out; to spread out; to leave out
널어놓다.n: emphasizes leaving things out afterward; the resulting state
cf: to hang out; to spread out to dry
the action of putting laundry out to dry

반딧불이.n: standard everyday name for the firefly in speech and textbooks

중립국.n: a country that takes no side in wars
cf: Abstract noun with suffix meaning the quality of being neutral; used in analysis, media, or debate.

허드렛일.n: low-status, rough or dirty tasks nobody wants
cf: desk and paperwork jobs, mostly in compounds
real work on the job, opposite of theory
tasks you handle at a company; only for workplace work
small miscellaneous workplace tasks, outside main duties
everyday small miscellaneous tasks, at home or at work; more casual
